strange_render_release_bar.head: strange_render
strange_render_release_bar.method: the labels-derived crossover. Isotonic regression of P(the human said >=3) against this head's own P(>=3), over all 3,085 labeled strange_render pictures scored through the staged artifact, ties pooled, non-decreasing; the crossing is the LOWEST score whose fitted agreement reaches a half, and the bar is that crossing rounded up to the next 0.005. Crossing 0.6809, 95% cluster bootstrap over places [0.540, 0.776]; the held-out selection slice crosses at 0.6987 on its own. Declared before it was read, and the roundings go up because a bar is a floor. STILL A >=3 BAR: the head's fourth class is preferred where it appears and gates nothing.
